The Lab/2013

MusiCose

c. 2013 · Web experiments

I made a sideways-scrolling website for a fictional band from Mars.

Dates & sources

Wayback preserves the site on 16 April 2013. Surviving source files carry October 2013 timestamps; the original launch date is not established.

Open the demo ↗Source ↗Archived site · 16 April 2013 ↗

MusiCose was my website for a fictional Martian band, with colorful panels that move sideways across the screen. You can use the keyboard to move between them.

The original site works again as a static demo. Its fictional contact controls are disabled.
